question: What independent per-row exposure-anchor precision is sufficient to close the unchanged P3U gates after the source-only P3V gauge failure?

anchor_observation.error_distribution: deterministic uniform within the stated hard ppm bound
anchor_observation.correction: observed source divided by one plus measured gain nuisance

unchanged_evaluation.observations: exact P3U 16/12/10-bit source and target observations
unchanged_evaluation.truth_cases: exact P3T six pure plus two mixed cases
unchanged_evaluation.mechanism_candidates: exact P3T physical and lens families
unchanged_evaluation.automatic_gates: exact P3U per-regime and common gates

controls: four prospectively frozen nonzero anchor-error bounds
forbidden: change precision levels, errors, roles, observations or gates after scoring
read targets or outcome metrics while constructing anchors
interpolate beyond the frozen precision ladder
claim a real meter, step wedge, film calibration or product readiness

branch_rule.pass: Retain the largest passing tested anchor bound as a synthetic acquisition precision requirement and next specify a controlled chart protocol.
branch_rule.fail: Close this anchor ladder without same-cohort rescue; require a materially different identifying observation before real-data work.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic acquisition-sufficiency evidence for an independent exposure anchor under exact P3U observations; no real-device, film, stock or product calibration claim.
